payload.title: Markus: pluggable image wrapper markup + FragmentTransform strip_header
payload.description: Two publication-neutral seams needed for exact Anth.us design parity. (1) ImagePipeline(wrap=callable): publication supplies the element wrapping the pipeline's / (receives request, layout, classes, inner html, intrinsic width/height). Anth.us needs gatsby-plugin-image's constrained shape (div.gatsby-image-wrapper + aspect-ratio sizer) because its CSS absolutely positions every img and the sizer provides height; a class_map cannot insert the sizer.
